route.dispatch: Choose the requested child targets; combine independent proposal/request files for accept.

retry.technical: Exact accepted request and proposal digests are idempotent.

invalidation.source_change: Consumers reading that source become stale.
invalidation.sibling_change: M9.2/M9.3 stale only when their actual registered sibling dependency changes.
invalidation.display_only_change: No invalidation unless a consumer explicitly reads /display.
